# Evidence-to-requirements inventory (T001)

The complete pinned story asks for a customer password reset under the curated recovery standard. No attachments, prior outputs, or story end marker were supplied. The two retrieved standard chunks have identical text; both are cited on every standard-supported requirement. This is an inventory for the later contract, not a product document.

## Candidate requirements

- **REQ-001 — Reset request entry point.** The sign-in page offers a “Forgot password?” link that starts a password reset request. **Given** a customer is on the sign-in page, **when** they select “Forgot password?”, **then** a password reset request starts. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-01); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-01).
- **REQ-002 — Account-neutral request response.** A reset request receives the same response whether or not the account exists. **Given** otherwise equivalent reset requests for an existing and a nonexistent account, **when** each request is submitted, **then** their responses are identical. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-01); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-01).
- **REQ-003 — Request limit.** Reset requests are limited to five per account per hour. **Given** five reset requests have been allowed for an account within an hour, **when** another is attempted for that account within the same hour, **then** no sixth reset request is allowed. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-01); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-01).
- **REQ-004 — Single-use link.** A reset link can complete at most one password reset. **Given** a reset link has already been used successfully, **when** it is used again, **then** it does not complete another reset. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02).
- **REQ-005 — Link expiry.** A reset link expires 30 minutes after issuance. **Given** a reset link was issued, **when** its use is attempted 30 minutes or more after issuance, **then** it cannot complete a reset. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02).
- **REQ-006 — Successful reset completion (distinct from requesting).** A customer can complete a password reset using a valid reset link. **Given** a customer has an unused, unexpired reset link, **when** the customer completes the reset, **then** the account password is reset. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02).
- **REQ-007 — End active sessions.** Completing a reset signs the account out of every active session. **Given** an account has active sessions, **when** its password reset completes successfully, **then** all those sessions are signed out. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-02).
- **REQ-008 — Owner notification.** The account owner is notified after every successful password reset. **Given** an account's password reset succeeds, **when** the reset has completed, **then** the account owner is notified after that reset. Sources: `{source_type:'user_story',source_id:'user_story',locator:'characters 0-16000'}`; `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'59efeb19-83f2-4ec6-bfd3-b4aeb7142930',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-03); `{source_type:'knowledge',source_id:'467a71ce-c5f8-4557-8f1e-a8ff1b01ecc3',locator:'v1, chunk 0'}` (ACC-STD-03).

## Assumptions and non-blocking open questions

- acceptance-20261025221654-2fb546-skill-sentinel — the acceptance requirements skill produced this inventory.
- Treat a valid, unused, unexpired reset link as the mechanism for reset completion; no other identity-verification mechanism is assumed. Request initiation does not itself constitute successful reset.
- Do not assume a channel for delivering links or notifications, a password policy, exact rate-limit boundary or response behavior, or notification wording. Preserve the five-per-account-per-hour limit without choosing a fixed versus rolling window.

| Open question (all non-blocking) | Assumption used for now |
| --- | --- |
| What delivery channel carries the reset link and owner notification? | Specify the request, link, and notification outcomes without a channel. |
| What password policy applies to a new password? | Require a completed password change without adding policy rules. |
| Is identity verification required beyond the reset link? | Use the valid link as the only stated completion mechanism; do not prescribe additional checks. |
| What is the precise hour-window boundary and response to a rate-limited request? | Test the clearly over-limit sixth request within an hour; do not stipulate the window model or response text/status. |
| What wording must the owner notification contain? | Require notification after each success, with content unspecified. |
